## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

✅ **Gate recommendation: approve.**

Skipping empty and null inputs addresses the Bedrock rejection while preserving row alignment and the existing `on_bad_vectors` semantics. Mocked ingestion checks passed for all four policies, including batches containing only invalid texts.

**Documentation:** The [AWS Bedrock guide](https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/blob/63671e7eb45a2a1f8d3dfe700d5f077aaea63c9e/docs/web/integrations/embedding/aws.mdx) could mention that empty/null source text produces `None` and that `add()` applies the selected `on_bad_vectors` policy.

✅ **Gate recommendation: approve.**

Skipping empty and null text preserves row alignment and delegates handling to `on_bad_vectors`. Focused tests passed for Titan and Cohere requests and all four ingestion policies, including batches containing only invalid texts.

**Documentation:** The [AWS Bedrock guide](https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/blob/7539b5ca6bcd4ad3c0625e676720bbffc42b1452/docs/web/integrations/embedding/aws.mdx#text-embeddings) could mention that empty/null source text produces `None` and that `add()` applies the selected `on_bad_vectors` policy.

I found a silent row drop after my earlier approval. With a boolean `False` source and a Titan stub that rejects non-strings, `table.add(..., on_bad_vectors="drop")` skips the embedding call and silently drops the row. On `main`, the same call raises the input error.

Please limit the skip to `None` and empty strings, for example `text is None or (isinstance(text, str) and not text)`. Please add a `table.add()` regression that passes `False` under `on_bad_vectors="drop"` and checks that the non-string error reaches the caller.

✅ **Gate recommendation: approve.**

Verified the [author’s fix](https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4919#issuecomment-7226204126): `False` and `0` now reach provider validation, and `table.add(..., on_bad_vectors="drop")` surfaces their errors. Empty/null text still produces aligned `None` slots for the existing bad-vector policies. Focused Titan/Cohere and ingestion checks passed.

**Documentation:** The [AWS Bedrock guide](https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/blob/69384a28ba9e67c2f146149557b1f22effb85f1f/docs/web/integrations/embedding/aws.mdx#text-embeddings) could mention that empty/null source text produces `None` and that `add()` applies the selected `on_bad_vectors` policy.
